prompts.sword2: Use case: stylized-concept. Redraw a game equipment icon in the EXACT flat casual visual language of the three supplied references. INPUT ROLES: image 1 is the equipment style reference; images 2 and 3 reinforce the ROUND proportions, very thick black contours, simple saturated flat fills, minimal cartoon shadow patches, small oval highlight dabs. These are style references, not output sheets. The reference's sticker-like simplicity is the primary requirement. Draw a single icon, square canvas, full isolated object, genuine transparent alpha background. Hand-drawn vector-like 2D cartoon symbol with smooth slightly playful rounded geometry. VERY THICK nearly black outline, uniform thickness around every outside edge, rounded line joins and caps; outline about 3 percent of object's width, clearly visible at thumbnail size. Only 2 flat tones per material and at most one small cream highlight dab. Big simple shapes, short stubby toy proportions, bright friendly casual mobile-game art. Front/near-front graphic view. No rendered metal, no gradients, no bevel facets, no painterly shading, no photorealistic reflections, no 3D, no fine detail, no scratches, no texture noise. Use a maximum of 6 flat fill colors overall. Center subject at about 74 percent of canvas with spacious margins. No background color, no checkerboard, no cast shadow, no UI tile, no label, no reference branding, no watermark. SUBJECT: one short chubby steel sword for item 강철검. Point diagonally from lower-left grip to upper-right tip, with a broad simple straight blade and softly rounded triangular tip, blade length only 1.8 times grip length. Blade pale icy gray-blue, with ONE broad darker gray-blue side stripe and ONE small off-white highlight patch. Thick black outline around blade. Compact butter-yellow rounded crossguard, flat orange underside patch, short terracotta-brown grip with just ONE dark grip stripe, tiny rounded yellow pommel. Keep the silhouette as simple as the single swords on image 1. Entire sword is about five large graphic shapes. Cute and casual, strong black outline is as important as the fill.
